jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Public Sector Management Accounting and Control
jobs.description:
The Department of Accounting invites applications for a PhD position in Public Sector Management Accounting and Control. The Department of Accounting is one of the oldest and largest accounting departments in Europe. We have a growing and flourishing research environment within financial accounting, management accounting and control, auditing, and corporate governance.

Public sector organizations continuously face demands for high service quality under increasingly tighter budget constraints while simultaneously being held accountable for their performance. Several attempts have been made to strengthen management accounting and control practices such as introducing new costing techniques, performance-based budgeting, benchmarking, and performance management. But despite these initiatives, public organizations still struggle to realize political objectives, which is further complicated by the development of new technologies and societal demands for sustainability. Within this context, the PhD application should reflect an independently formulated research project that addresses questions related to the role and effects of management accounting and control practice in public sector organizations at state, regional and/or municipal level. Potential research areas are:

• 
Developing and using performance measurement and management to create public value

• 
The influence of new technologies on management accounting and control practices

• 
The use of financial/non-financial information by public officials and politicians

• 
The development and/or use of budgeting for public sector decision-making

• 
The role of accounting in strategic development and public organization management

The PhD candidate will be part of the department’s management accounting research group. We focus on examining various subjects related to management accounting and control within both private and public sectors. For this PhD position, we welcome all forms of research methodologies and theoretical approaches, but we prioritize research inquiring specifically into organizational practices. We are open to candidates from different academic backgrounds both within and outside business administration.

The candidate will be expected to teach within management and control. As many courses are taught in Danish, priority will be given to candidates with language proficiencies in Danish, Swedish or Norwegian.

About the PhD programme
The three-year PhD programme at CBS gives you the opportunity to conduct research under the supervision of CBS’s associate professors and professors, supported by research related PhD courses. The programme is highly international, and you are expected to participate in international research conferences and to spend time at another research institution as a visiting PhD student. See the CBS homepage for more information about the PhD programme, https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programmeme. 

CBS PhD graduates are held in high esteem not only in academia and research institutions but also in government and business where their research qualifications are in high demand.

CBS is committed to ensuring excellence, transformative and relevant teaching and research. Candidates who wish to join us must be interested in working in an organisation of this type and it is expected that the applicant will show an interest in joining the department's research environment. You can read more about the department's research here: www.cbs.dk/acc. 

Application and admission requirements
The department will give priority to applicants with high grades from their universities. To be considered the applicant must:

• 
have a basic education at master's level (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process)

• 
have received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master's thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale (https://ufm.dk/en/education/the-danish-education-system/grading-system)

• 
have a weighted grade point average of at least 8.2 on the Danish 7-point grading scale for the bachelor's and master's degree combined or alternatively a weighted grade point average must be at least 9.5 for the master's degree alone. If the grade point average is not met, documentation for being in the top 40% of the class is also accepted. In rare cases, the grade requirement can be waived.

• 
have completed the master's programme before starting the PhD programme at CBS

• 
master academic English at a high level in writing and speaking

The application (see link below) must include a five-page project description. The project description must include:

• 
a presentation of an original research question

• 
a description of the initial theoretical framework and method

• 
a presentation of the proposed empirical material

• 
a work plan for the three years

More information can be found here: https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programmemes/admission

In addition to the project description, copies of the following must be included:

• 
diploma for bachelor's and master's degree or other certificates at an equivalent level as well as the grade transcripts

• 
documentation for being in the top 40% of the class (if grade requirements are not met)

• 
a concise curriculum vitae (CV)

• 
a list of articles and publications (if applicable)

• 
one example of a selected written work (e.g. master's thesis)

The PhD student is enrolled in the CBS PhD School. Further information about PhD scholarships and the PhD programme can be found at https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programmeme.

Information about the department can be found at https://www.cbs.dk/forskning/institutter-centre/institut-regnskab.

For additional information regarding the PhD position, feel free to contact Associate Professor, Tim Neerup Themsen, tnt.acc@cbs.dk.

Employment and salary
A PhD scholarship runs for a period of three years and includes teaching obligations corresponding to 416 work hours. The scholarships are fully salaried positions, according to the national Danish collective agreement. The monthly salary is currently approximately DKK 30,264 up to DKK 36,877 depending on seniority and a pension contribution totaling 18.07%. The scholarship includes tuition fees, office space, course and travel costs (according to the current CBS agreement). 

Salary level and employment take place in accordance with the Ministry of Finance's agreement with the Academics' Central Organization.

Recruitment procedure
The Recruitment Committee shortlists at least two-five applicants to be assessed by the Assessment Committee. Applicants are informed whether their application has proceeded for assessment.

Applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and will receive their personal assessment later. Selected applicants will be invited for an interview. Please note that a positive assessment does not automatically result in an interview. Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application. 

The application must be sent via the online link below. 

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see above), by the application deadline.

Details about Copenhagen Business School are available at www.cbs.dk/en.

Application due 11/11/2026

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Mathematical Modeling for Health Policy - DTU Management
jobs.description:
Are you interested in research in cutting edge modeling techniques addressing urgent questions in health? Are you interested in quantitative methods that can be applied to relevant policy questions? 

This position involves a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of policy relevant questions and mathematical modeling methods to answer some of the following questions: How can we develop multi-disease models to quantify overall health outcomes? What interventions in and out of the healthcare system improve outcomes for multiple diseases?

The Department of Technology, Management and Economics at Technical University of Denmark invites applications for a 3-year PhD position in disease modeling and Cost-Effectiveness Analysis starting in February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The PhD student will be part of the Management Science Division and affiliated with the Operations & Supply Chain Management Section.

The project will include:

• Developing multiple models for cardiovascular disease, Type 2 diabetes, and stroke and integrating them into one model 
• Estimating the health effects and costs of non-healthcare interventions that prevent metabolic disease over the next 20 years in Denmark
• Conduct a cost-effectiveness analysis
• Develop methods to improve modeling of multiple diseases
Copenhagen — ranked the world's most livable city — offers a safe, sustainable urban environment, a rich cultural scene, and an enviable work-life balance. As part of DTU Management, you'll combine this quality of life with a dynamic, interdisciplinary research setting at one of Europe's leading technical universities."

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will work with academics and healthcare professionals to develop modelling methods to improve health policy modeling and assessment. As a PhD student, you will: 

• Be responsible for conducting your own research project
• Contribute to new knowledge about health policy modeling
• Strive to publish your work worldwide in recognised journals
• Collaborate with researchers from the Management Science Division
• Present your work at international conferences and seminars
• Assist in teaching and co-supervise engineering students with their thesis work
• Take classes equivalent to 30 ECTS over the PhD project period
The PhD scholarship is a full-time position allowing you to become a research scientist and benefit from the academic activities at the department. The yearly salary is internationally highly competitive. Department duty work (teaching) is very limited, allowing you to focus on your PhD project. 

The PhD project will be supervised by Assistant Professor Anneke Claypool and co-supervised by Professor Martin Utley and the candidates for the PhD position will be assessed on the following criteria:

• Profound knowledge in Operations Research and Management Science and/or disease modeling
• Knowledge in and practical experiences with programming (e.g., Python, Java, Julia, R, etc.)
• Knowledge in healthcare operations management, health policy modeling, cost-effectiveness analysis, health economic assessment, and related fields
We seek to recruit a PhD student with experience in simulation modeling, an interest in health policy, and a background in management science, operations research, computer science, applied mathematics, quantitative health policy, epidemiology, or a related field.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained by contacting Assistant Professor Anneke Claypool, e-mail: alacl@dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Management at www.man.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 6 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A 1-page research statement describing how you would formulate a research project based on the given information
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

Who are we?
DTU Management conducts excellent research in the intersection between management, technology and economics. We develop solutions in close cooperation with companies and public authorities. Our research aims at strengthening welfare, productivity and sustainability within society. A key element is the role of technology and its interaction with industry and individuals. The department offers a wide range of courses and programs at bachelor, master and PhD level across DTU’s study programs. The department has around 200 employees, approximately 50% coming from abroad. In the Management Science Division, the research ranges from mathematical-based optimization models to process-oriented management models and is used in basically every sector, such as transport, energy infrastructure, the education sector, as well as the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship in Natural Language Processing
jobs.description:
PhD Project in Cultural Reasoning with Language Models

The AI Section at the Department of Computer Science invites applicants for a PhD fellowship in computational modelling and evaluation of cultural interpretation with language models. The position is part of the research project “CuRe: Cultural Reasoning for Responsible Language Model Development” (DFF project 5334-00088B), funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark.

The expected start date is February 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The project

Language models can produce fluent interpretations of texts while obscuring the cultural assumptions, uncertainty and alternative readings underlying their answers. CuRe investigates how language models understand and reason about culture, ambiguity and interpretation, and how these capabilities can be evaluated and improved to support responsible language model development. Literary texts provide a demanding testbed: their interpretation depends on historical and cultural knowledge, close attention to textual evidence and the ability to accommodate several plausible readings.

The PhD candidate will develop computational methods and evaluation resources for culturally grounded interpretation. Working closely with researchers in natural language processing and literary studies, the candidate is expected to:

• 
construct datasets and benchmarks linking literary passages, relevant cultural and historical context, textual evidence and expert or reader interpretations;

• 
analyse what cultural knowledge and interpretive strategies language models use, where their interpretations fail and how confidently they present uncertain conclusions;

• 
develop methods for grounding interpretations in evidence and for representing uncertainty, ambiguity and multiple plausible interpretations;

• 
evaluate the resulting methods through automatic experiments and studies with literary scholars and other readers; and

• 
publish the results in leading venues in natural language processing, artificial intelligence and computational humanities.

 The exact research questions will be refined together with the successful candidate. Relevant methodological directions include language model evaluation and probing, retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation, explicit representations of interpretive evidence and uncertainty, data annotation, human-centred evaluation and multilingual or cross-cultural analysis. The empirical work will primarily use modern Scandinavian literary texts, while aiming to develop methods and findings that generalise beyond literature. The project includes a planned research stay at McGill University.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for candidates with a strong computational background and an interest in how language, culture and interpretation can be studied rigorously. Applicants may have a background in natural language processing, computational linguistics, computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data science, digital humanities or a closely related field. Formal training in literary studies is not required, but the successful candidate must be motivated to work across disciplinary boundaries and to engage seriously with humanities research questions.

Our group and research- and what do we offer?

The PhD fellow will join the CoAStaL research group and the AI Section at the Department of Computer Science. The research environment brings together faculty, postdoctoral researchers and PhD students working on multilingual and cross-cultural NLP, multimodality, language model training and evaluation, responsible AI and computational humanities. The section collaborates broadly with leading research groups in Denmark and abroad.

CuRe is an interdisciplinary collaboration with the Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics at the University of Copenhagen. The project builds on established joint work in computational literary studies and provides access to large literary corpora, domain expertise and relevant annotation resources. The PhD fellow will therefore be part of both a technically strong NLP environment and a close collaboration with literary scholars.

The group is part of the Department of Computer Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. We are located in Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern GPU computing resources, shared data and annotation infrastructure and access to relevant text corpora.

Principal supervisor: Associate Professor Desmond Elliott, Department of Computer Science, de@di.ku.dk.

Co-supervisor: Tenure-Track Assistant Professor Daniel Hershcovich, Department of Computer Science, dh@di.ku.dk.

Co-supervisor: Associate Professor Jens Bjerring-Hansen, Department of Nordic Studies and Linguistics, jbh@hum.ku.dk.

The PhD programme

The position is offered as a three-year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme).

Qualifications needed
To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. [relevant educations]. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

Terms of employment 

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 31,800 DKK/approx. 4,200 EUR (August 2026-level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

Responsibilities and tasks

• 
Carry through an independent research project under supervision

• 
Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE

• 
Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad

• 
Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities

• 
Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals

• 
Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project

We are looking for the following qualifications:

• 
A master’s degree or equivalent qualification relevant to the PhD project.

• 
Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience with machine learning or natural language processing tools.

• 
Knowledge of modern NLP and language models and an ability to design, implement and evaluate computational experiments.

• 
Experience with one or more of the following is an advantage: language model evaluation, retrieval or retrieval-augmented generation, data annotation, interpretability, multilingual NLP or computational humanities.

• 
Relevant research experience, publications, thesis work or professional activities.

• 
Ability to work independently, formulate research questions and collaborate across computer science and the humanities.

• 
A curious and critical mindset with a strong interest in culture, interpretation and responsible AI.

• 
Excellent written and spoken English. Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or experience with literary analysis is an advantage but not a requirement.

Application and Assessment Procedure

Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Please include: 

• 
Motivated letter of application (maximum one page) explaining your motivation for the project, your relevant qualifications and the research directions that particularly interest you.

• 
Curriculum vitae including information about your education, research or work experience, language skills and other skills relevant to the position.

• 
Original diplomas for bachelor’s and master’s degrees and transcripts of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in a language other than English or Danish. If the master’s degree has not yet been completed, a certified or signed recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted.

• 
Publication list, if applicable.

• 
Reference letters, if available.

Application deadline: 

The deadline for applications is November 8th, 2026, 23:59 CET

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process 
After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

The assessor will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above-mentioned research area, techniques, skills and other requirements. The assessor will conclude whether each applicant is qualified and, if so, for which of the two models. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Interviews with selected candidates are expected to be held in week 49.

Questions
For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the project supervisor Daniel Hershcovich at dh@di.ku.dk or +45 53 33 88 04.

[General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website: https://www.science.ku.dk/phd/].

The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

jobs.occupation: Manager, GTM Operations and Enablement
jobs.description:
Manager, GTM Operations and Enablement

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Role

Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions - Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As Manager, GTM Operations and Enablement, you'll set the standard for how GTM processes are designed, governed, and continuously improved, and you'll own the enablement methodology and launch readiness framework that keep execution consistent as we scale. You'll lead a small operations team, and partner closely with Product on launch readiness and funnel governance.

Responsibilities

> Own and maintain the stage/funnel definition framework — the documented, governed standard for what each pipeline stage means across Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led, including the audit process that keeps motions compliant with it.

> Build and maintain the enablement methodology toolkit — playbook templates, certification criteria, and onboarding frameworks that motion-level teams use to run their own enablement, plus the review process that keeps that toolkit current.

> Own the launch and market readiness framework, ensuring new products and campaigns hit the market with the right cross-functional prep.

> Define and track the funnel health and enablement scorecards — stage conversion rates, launch readiness scores, methodology/certification adoption — that show whether the standards are actually working, and use them to prioritize the CI roadmap.

> Run continuous improvement (CI) cycles that identify friction across the funnel and turn it into standardized process fixes, grounded in the scorecard data above.

> Lead and grow a small operations team, keeping their work aligned to one set of standards regardless of which functions it spans.

> Partner closely with Product on launch readiness and stage/funnel governance.

Requirements

Experience > 5+ years of experience in GTM/sales enablement, revenue operations, or process design, ideally across more than one go-to-market motion.

> Experience managing a small, functionally diverse team.

Process & Program Skills > Track record of building methodology and standards that other teams adopt and run with - not just delivering enablement content yourself.

> Strong process-design instincts: comfortable defining funnel stages, launch checklists, and CI frameworks from scratch.

**

Operating Skills

**> Confident partnering with Product and cross-functional teams on launch and market readiness.

> Clear, structured communicator who can turn ambiguous process gaps into simple, adoptable standards.

> Comfortable setting standards for teams with different day-to-day priorities, without owning their execution.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we’re happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

Usercentrics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Product Finance
jobs.description:
Pandora jewellery is loved by millions. Do you want to help keep the company as strong as the love its products attract? ... If so, this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for!

Pandora sells more jewellery than any brand in the world, at a gross margin of around 80 percent, among the strongest in consumer goods. That strength is what lets the brand keep creating, designing, crafting and showing up for the people who wear it, and what earns the trust of the investors who back it. Guarding it, piece by piece and collection by collection, is what this newly created role is for. We deliver on our promises, and precious metals at multi-year highs are testing every jewellery maker's discipline right now. The brands that keep their craft and their strength through it will set the pace. That is the work, and it starts immediately.

Pandora's success is built on product: design that powers both the love for the brand and the profit that sustains it, and an assortment where every piece earns its place, in the stores and in people's hearts. You will build product profitability governance with our Product organization: what enters the assortment and on what threshold, what leaves it and when, and how design, cost, price and mix add up to a portfolio that earns steady love from millions.

You lead through mandate and the forums you chair, not headcount: the team is deliberately senior and flat, and your counterparts are the CPO leadership team, Merchandising, Revenue Growth Management, Craft & Supply finance and the CFO office. Your work is in front of the Executive Leadership Team every cycle, at the center of the company's strategic agenda.

What you will do

• Design and chair the product gate and lifecycle forums, moving with the assortment cycle: thresholds set, decisions evidenced, follow-through visible, and a line where every piece earns its place.

• Own the numbers behind what every product costs and earns, hands-on in the cost and BI systems, and build the story behind them, told at Executive Leadership and investor standard.

• Partner Product Strategy, Merchandising, pricing and Craft & Supply finance on how design choices become cost, how whole product families keep earning as they grow, and the link between what we choose to sell and what we charge.

• Hold the finance position with senior product stakeholders on thresholds and lifecycle decisions, and keep the partnership strong while you do it.

• Direct a product finance analyst on content and draw on a shared analytics bench built for exactly this work. Contribute to building agentic capabilities to expand the value you deliver.

What is needed to succeed

• 10+ years in product or gross margin finance from vertically integrated retail or consumer goods; you have run a costing or product-profitability function, not only analyzed one.

• Hands-on analytical depth that has stayed recent: you build and defend margin baselines yourself, and master data is familiar ground.

• A track record of building governance that held: gates or lifecycle forums with thresholds that survived contested, sponsored proposals.

• Credibility in front of a CFO and a CPO in the same meeting.

Who you are

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Computational Mass Spectrometry Imaging and Spatial Metabolomics
jobs.description:
PhD Position in Computational Mass Spectrometry Imaging and Spatial Metabolomics
Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at the Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Roskilde Campus, Denmark, within the Environmental Science and Toxicology department. The position is available from February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Title
PhD Position in Computational Mass Spectrometry Imaging and Spatial Metabolomics

Research area and project description
Spatial metabolomics enables the study of biochemical processes and human–environment interactions at micrometer to cellular resolution (single cell metabolomics). Mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) is increasingly used to investigate how environmental stressors and micropollutants affect biological systems across space and time. However, data processing, image segmentation, multimodal image registration, reproducible computational workflows and biological interpretation remain major challenges.

This project will develop computational methods and open-source tools for processing, analyzing and interpreting MSI and spatial metabolomics data. The methods will be applied to microbial communities, environmental samples and tissues to uncover spatially resolved biotransformation processes and metabolic responses to environmental stressors.

The successful candidate will work at the interface of computational science, biochemistry, microbiology and analytical chemistry. The project will combine computational method development with experimental spatial metabolomics including signal preprocessing, machine learning, spatial statistics, image registration and interactive software development. The PhD student will join an interdisciplinary team of chemists, microbiologists, biologists and computational scientists and contribute to both methodological development and biological applications.

The position includes:
• Developing batch-processing workflows for MSI and metabolomics data, including normalization, quantification and feature alignment.
• Developing spatial segmentation methods, including uncertainty-aware and spatially regularized clustering.
• Collaborating with experimental scientists, mass spectrometrists and biologists to validate methods against experimental and biological datasets. Ensure reliable implementation of automated quality control, testing, documentation and reproducibility reporting.
• Communicating computational results clearly to interdisciplinary and non-computational re-searchers. Processing and analyzing imaging datasets and presenting results at internal and international scientific meetings.
• Publishing methodological and application studies and releasing well-documented open-source software.
• Close supervision and collaboration with dedicated researchers and senior investigators.
Project description
For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please simply copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Qualifications and specific competences
We are seeking highly motivated candidates with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research. Applicants should hold a master’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, bioinformatics/ cheminformatics, AI/ML, data science, chemistry, computational biology, chemometrics, analytical chemistry or a related discipline.

Essential qualifications:
• Solid background in computational chemistry, image processing, omics data analysis and/or mass spectrometry
• Strong interest in spatial metabolomics and its applicationsDesirable qualifications:
• Experience with mass spectrometry, microscopy, microbial systems, or analytical chemistry
• Ability to work independently as well as in collaborative, interdisciplinary teams
Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Environmental Science, Roskilde Campus, Frederiksborgvej 399, 4000 Roskilde, Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
 
• Prasad Phapale, prasad.phapale@envs.au.dk (main supervisor)
For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

jobs.occupation: Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team
jobs.description:
Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team

Location: Farum, Denmark | Level: PhD / Postdoc / Experienced Engineer

The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

At Ibsen Photonics, we are developing Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures. We are looking for creative, hands-on Optical Design Engineers to take full ownership of designing, building, and optimising our SBC platform.

This role bridges the gap between theoretical physics and industrial reality. You won’t just design on a screen; you will spend significant time in the lab, iterating rapidly from proof-of-concept to robust, production-ready, scalable systems.

Key responsibilities:

• Design & Assemble: Develop compact, efficient SBC modules using Ibsen’s world-class transmission gratings, while considering optical beam paths, thermal effects and mechanical constraints.

• System Optimisation: Drive performance by refining optical alignment, mechanical stability, and complex thermal management for high-power loads in a reiterative process: design – experiment – optimise.

• Characterisation: Use advanced diagnostics to maintain beam quality (low M²) during power scaling, including wavefront sensing and spectral analysis.

• Full Lifecycle Ownership: Source optical/mechanical components and manage the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs.

• Global Collaboration: Work closely with an internal team and international partners, including potential overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing.

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a “build-test-learn” environment. Ideally, you possess:

• Education: A PhD or Postdoc in Optics, Photonics, Laser Physics, or a related field.

• Expertise:

• Hands on experience with (high-power) fibre and free-space optical systems, precise alignment, and experimental troubleshooting.

• Understanding of (and ideally experience with) SBC and CBC beam combining techniques.

• Beam quality measurement and analysis.

• Mechanical design of low-tolerance devices

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Gaussian optics, beam propagation, and high-power laser effects (thermal lensing, runaway-effects, mitigation strategies).

• Software Skills: Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g., Zemax) and familiarity with mechanical CAD.

• Mindset: Independent enough to drive a project and work on your own, but collaborative enough to thrive in a flat-hierarchy, cross-functional team, sharing insights and discussing projects/next steps. The role is highly experimental and hands-on, requiring independence and a strong drive to make systems work in practice, not just on paper.

• Security Clearance: You are a European citizen with no family ties to Russia or Russian allied territories, and you have a clean criminal record.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• High Impact: Your designs will directly shape the future of high-brightness laser systems for manufacturing, defence, telecommunications, and science.

• Freedom to Innovate: We value experimental drive—if you have a better way to align or stabilise a system, we want to see it.

• Danish Engineering Culture: Enjoy a supportive environment with fast decision-making, real ownership, and a healthy work-life balance.

jobs.occupation: Specialistläkare/överläkare inom kardiologi till Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse, Danmark
jobs.description:
Om du är på jakt för nya utmaningar på jobbet och funderar på att jobba i Danmark är kardiologen på Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse ett självklart val.

Här kan du vara med och påverka framtidens hjärtmedicin och samtidigt få möjlighet att utveckla och leda ditt eget specialområde.

På hjärtmedicinska avdelningen (Medicin 2) kommer du som specialistläkare att spela en central roll för den kliniska verksamheten och yrkesområdets utveckling. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med avdelningens övriga specialistläkare, chefer och andra professioner för att skapa smidiga och sammanhängande patientförlopp.

Yrkesmässiga utmaningar och ett flexibelt arbetsliv

Som specialistläkare hos oss får du inte bara en tjänst. Du får möjlighet att styra inriktningen inom ett eller flera specialområden, om du har ambitionen och intresset för det.

Du får

• möjlighet att ta ansvar för och utveckla ett helt eget specialområde inom exempelvis ischemi, arytmi, hjärtklaffssjukdomar eller bilddiagnostik i form av ekokardiografi, hjärt-CT och hjärt-MR

• möjlighet att delta i forskningen vid avdelningen

• möjlighet att ingå i en högspecialiserad miljö med engagerade kollegor

• ett nära samarbete med övriga professioner och en hög grad av kollegialt utbyte.

Dessutom kan vi anpassa tjänsten så att den passar dina behov. På Medicin 2 lägger vi stor vikt vid att skapa balans mellan arbete och fritid, och vi prioriterar stort inflytande och ansvar.

Om dig

Vi tror att du

• är specialistläkare i kardiologi, eller är på väg att bli det

• fokuserar på att utveckla vårdkvaliteten och förbättra patientförloppet

• trivs i en miljö där man både för ett nära samarbete och arbetar självständigt

• bidrar till en aktiv och god arbetsmiljö

• har ett intresse för kvalitet, utbildning och eventuellt forskning

• kommunicerar öppet och konstruktivt.

Om oss

Vår avdelning bedriver verksamhet i två olika lokaler i Næstved respektive Slagelse, som ligger 30 km från varandra.

I Slagelse består avdelningen av två vårdavdelningar med 24 respektive 20 sängplatser. Därutöver har vi en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning.

I Næstved består avdelningen av ett trombos- och koagulationscentrum, en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning. Utöver detta rymmer lokalerna även ett diagnostiskt centrum.

Vi är för närvarande 12 specialistläkare inom kardiologi samt specialistläkare inom avdelningens övriga specialistfunktioner.

Vi ansvarar för undervisningen av medicinstudenter från Köpenhamns universitet.

Därför ska du välja Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital fokuserar vi på yrkeskompetens, samarbete mellan professioner, kvalitet, utbildning och forskning.

Specialister spelar en central roll både för den kliniska verksamheten och för den ämnesspecifika utvecklingen, och du blir en del av en miljö med hög grad av specialisering, tydliga ambitioner och goda möjligheter att påverka utvecklingen inom ditt specialistområde.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där fokus ligger på vårdkvalitet, kontinuitet i patientförloppet och förutsättningar som främjar såväl kliniskt arbete som utbildning och forskning.

Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats kommer att vara i Slagelse som har goda transportförbindelser med bland annat Odense, Köpenhamn och övriga Själland.

Är du redo för nästa steg?

Vill du vara med och utveckla kardiologin på Midt- og Vestsjælland? Då ser vi gärna att du hör av dig.

Mer information

Om du vill ha mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta tillförordnad chefsläkare Roman Sykulski på tel. +45 56 51 41 34 eller chefsjuksköterska Camilla Vest på tel. +45 93 56 84 89.

Villkor, lön och anställning

Du kommer att ingå i ett jourteam med bakjoursansvar från ditt eget hem i egenskap av överläkare och ha jour utanför arbetsplatsen i egenskap av specialistläkare.

Vi har omfattande erfarenhet av att hitta flexibla lösningar som möjliggör ett hållbart arbetsliv, så kontakta oss gärna för ett förutsättningslöst samtal om vilka möjligheter som finns.

Den professionella bedömningen av sökanden kommer att baseras på sökandens uppgifter om sina egna kompetenser i förhållande till de sju läkartjänsterna. Om du söker en tjänst som överläkare kommer en professionell bedömning att genomföras som kommer att vara avgörande för din kvalifikation som överläkare.

Anställningen sker enligt avtalet mellan Danske Regioner och YL/Overlægeforeningen, beroende på vilken tjänst som söks, och är villkorad med att det finns en tillfredsställande børneattest (utdrag ur belastningsregistret som visar om en person dömts för sexualbrott mot barn under 15 år).

Vi önskar tillsätta tjänsten senast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Hjälp med flytt och undervisning i danska

Om du vill flytta till Danmark i samband med anställningen erbjuder vi kostnadsfri, professionell hjälp med flytt och bosättning nära sjukhuset eller eventuellt i Köpenhamn. Du får hjälp med allt från att hitta boende till registrering och eventuella medföljande familjemedlemmar.

En viktig del av arbetet som specialistläkare är kommunikationen mellan läkare och patient. För patientsäkerhetens skull kräver därför Region Sjælland att våra specialistläkare ska ha kunskaper i danska språket på en tillfredsställande nivå. Vi tillhandahåller därför en språklärare för privatundervisning så att du så snabbt som möjligt kan kommunicera med dina patienter på en nivå där ni förstår varandra.

Det innebär att vi förväntar oss att du är inställd på att lägga tid på att lära dig danska, både i tal och skrift.

Se mer om vad vi erbjuder i form av hjälp här

Rekryteringsprocessen

När vi har mottagit din ansökan kommer vi att bedöma om dina kvalifikationer matchar det vi söker, och du kommer initialt att bjudas in till en intervju via Teams. Om båda parter är intresserade av att fortsätta dialogen kommer du att bjudas in till ett rekryteringssamtal på sjukhuset, där du får träffa avdelningens ledning och personal samt vår HR- och språkkonsult.

Ansökningstid

Vi kommer att granska ansökningarna till tjänsten löpande, så vänta inte för länge med att ansöka.

Verksamhetsområde

Den 1 januari 2027 slås Region Själland och Region Hovedstaden samman och bildar Region Østdanmark till följd av sjukvårdsreformen. Ditt verksamhetsområde kommer att vara Region Østdanmark, inklusive alla tillhörande organisatoriska enheter.

Läs mer om vad verksamhetsområdet innebär på Region Østdanmarks webbplats.

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbetar vi varje dag för att främja ett hälsosamt liv genom förebyggande åtgärder och behandling inom ramen för en samordnad hälso- och sjukvårdsinsats. Som sjukhus förenar vi psykiatri och somatik. Vårt mål är att patienter och medborgare ska få bra och trygg vård av hög kvalitet.

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett innovativt, kompetent och organisatoriskt stabilt sjukhus där vi gör skillnad för de människor som behöver oss. Lärande och utveckling är en del av vardagen och sker i professionella sammanhang med ett gemensamt ansvar. Det sker även mellan olika avdelningar.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital betjänar ett upptagningsområde med cirka 230 000 invånare. Vi har 766 vårdplatser och cirka 5 000 anställda fördelade på 20 avdelningar, däribland 16 somatiska och psykiatriska avdelningar.

Vi erbjuder en gedigen forskningsmiljö med 13 professorer och en stark yrkesmässig utbildningsmiljö, där vi varje år välkomnar cirka 2 700 studenter, elever och läkare som deltar i vidareutbildning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

jobs.occupation: Customer Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us

nShift is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

**Purpose of role

**As a Customer Manager, you'll own the long-term success and commercial growth of a portfolio of mid- & enterprise sized customers across your home market in Denmark. You'll be the face of nShift to these accounts - a trusted adviser who understands their business, anticipates their needs, and helps them unlock more value from our platform over time.

This is a role for someone who loves building real relationships, is energised by commercial conversations and takes genuine pride in customer outcomes. You'll work across nShift's full product portfolio - delivery management, checkout, tracking and returns - and collaborate closely with Support, Product, Professional Services and Marketing to make sure your customers are always getting the most out of what we offer.

**Overall Responsibilities

**

• Full commercial ownership of a portfolio of customers, with accountability for net revenue retention and expansion

• Drive upsell and cross-sell opportunities across nShift's full product suite, identifying where customers can unlock additional value

• Own renewals end-to-end - building strong relationships well in advance of contract dates and proactively managing risk to prevent churn

• Develop and execute account plans for your customers, aligning nShift's roadmap and capabilities to their long-term business goals

• Build and maintain relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, from day-to-day champions to C-suite executives

• Maintain an accurate and healthy pipeline of expansion and renewal opportunities in Salesforce

• Use data and business insights to make compelling cases for adoption, expansion, and deeper integration

• Act as the voice of the customer internally — feeding market intelligence and customer feedback into Product, Marketing, and Leadership

• Represent nShift at customer meetings, industry events and trade shows across the region

**Must-haves

**

• Proven track record in account management or B2B SaaS sales, with strong experience managing renewals and driving expansion revenue

• Excellent communication and presentation skills - you're comfortable in a boardroom and equally at ease in a working session with a technical team

• Ability to manage a complex portfolio of accounts simultaneously, prioritising effectively and staying proactive rather than reactive

• Strong commercial acumen - you understand SaaS contracts, pricing structures, and how to build a compelling business case

• Data-driven mindset: you use numbers to understand account health, identify opportunities, and make persuasive arguments

• A genuine passion for building long-term customer relationships, not just closing deals

• Fluency in Danish and English; proficiency in Dutch or German is an advantage.

• Located in Copenhagen, Aarhus or Silkeborg

**Nice to have

**

• Experience in logistics, e-commerce, retail, or supply chain — or working with customers in these sectors

• Familiarity with multi-carrier shipping, parcel delivery, or returns management platforms

• Experience with Salesforce or a similar enterprise CRM

• A network of relevant contacts across the Nordic retail or logistics landscape

**What We Offer

**

• A commercial role with real ownership and direct impact on revenue

• A collaborative, international team that genuinely cares about doing right by customers

• Competitive salary with performance-based commission

• The chance to grow with a category-leading company at a pivotal point in its journey

• Flexible working with regular travel across the Nordics, Benelux and UK based on your customer portfolio

**Please ensure you upload your CV in English

**At nShift we believe in embracing diversity in all forms and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone which we believe is essential for our continued success. We're an equal-opportunity employer which means that all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity, or disability status.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (Full-stack)
jobs.description:
Oplysninger om lønniveau kommer fra kapa.ai

Oplysninger om dette lønniveau kommer fra kapa.ai. Din faktiske løn vil være baseret på dine kompetencer og din erfaring – tal med din rekrutteringskonsulent for at høre mere.

Grundlønsniveau

100.000,00 US$/år - 150.000,00 US$/år

Kapa makes technical knowledge instantly accessible through AI assistants. As a software engineer you will work across the stack on the Kapa systems that answer thousands of developer questions per day. Check out Docker’s documentation (https://docs.docker.com) for a live example of what Kapa is (look for the “Ask AI” button).

**In This Role, You Will

**

• 
Work directly with the founding team and our research engineers.

• 
Scale the infrastructure that powers the Kapa RAG engine (Python).

• 
Experiment with new features in the Kapa analytics platform (React + Python).

• 
Work on the client integrations which are used to deploy Kapa for our customers (React + Python).

• 
Give Kapa access to new kinds of data (Python).

• 
Maintain our React SDK.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

**

• 
A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics or a related field.

• 
3+ years of software engineering experience working on complex systems in both backend and frontend.

• 
An affinity for machine learning, deep learning (including LLMs) and natural language processing.

• 
The ability to work effectively in a fast in a environment where things are sometimes loosely defined.

• 
This is neither an exhaustive nor necessary set of attributes. Even if none of these apply to you, but you believe you will contribute to kapa.ai, please reach out.
